EvenAddEvenEqEven.code: EvenAddEvenEqEven (a b : ℕ) : Even a ∧ Even b → Even (a + b)
EvenAddEvenEqEven.description: The sum of two even natural numbers is also even.

OneAddOneEqTwo.description: Adding one to one results in two.

n8x_then_n4x.code: n8x_then_n4x (n : ℕ) : (∃ a, n = 8 * a) → ∃ b, n = 4 * b
n8x_then_n4x.description: If a natural number is divisible by eight, then it is also divisible by four.
